sectionSubtitle: Practical software development projects by Soriya Mut, from study tools to database applications.

projects.title: Student Study Management System
projects.description: A completed web application that solves the problem of scattered study planning by organizing learning activities, progress tracking, and schedules in one place. My role was to build the learning project and its user interface with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Flask. Key features include activity organization, progress tracking, and study planning.
projects.purpose: Organize learning activities, progress, and study schedules in one focused application.
projects.contribution: Built the learning project and its user interface as part of practical web development study.
projects.learning: Practiced connecting a responsive frontend to a Python web application.

projects.title: Portfolio Study Space
projects.description: A completed personal portfolio that presents Soriya Mut's IT studies, skills, journey, and projects in one accessible place. My role was to design and build the portfolio with vanilla HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON-driven content. Features include responsive sections, bilingual content, theme switching, and interactive study-focused elements.
projects.purpose: Create a clear public home for Soriya Mut's studies, skills, journey, and projects.
projects.contribution: Designed and built the portfolio interface, content system, and interactive study-focused elements.
projects.learning: Practiced organizing content for people and search engines while keeping the experience personal.

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.description: An in-progress database learning project that addresses the challenge of organizing books, members, and borrowing workflows. My role is to develop and practice the application with Python, Flask, and SQL. The project focuses on clear user flows, relational data, and library management fundamentals.
projects.purpose: Explore how a database application can organize books, members, and borrowing workflows.
projects.contribution: Developing the learning project and practicing its application flow with Python, Flask, and SQL.
projects.learning: Building understanding of relational data, database design, and backend fundamentals.
